newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN says three-month sales slightly up.
newsitem.headline: MAN says three-month sales slightly up.

text.p: German truck manufacturer and engineering group MAN AG said on Wednesday that its sales from July to September rose to 3.8 billion marks from 3.6 billion marks in the year-ago period.
MAN also said in a statement at its annual news conference that incoming orders during the three-month period rose to 5.4 billion marks from 5.3 billion marks.
The Munich-based group said the trend continued into October.
MAN said domestic sales during the first quarter of its business year, which ends June 30, fell 15 percent to 1.26 billion marks from 1.47 billion marks in the year-ago period.
But foreign sales rorse 18 percent to 2.57 billion marks from 2.17 billion marks in the 1995 period.
Orders in hand rose to 19.23 billion marks from 17.62 billion marks, while the workforce dropped by 300 to 57,826.
